hero_sub: AuraFlux exists so creators can ship Shorts from stream peaks (Most Replayed, chat spikes, CCV) without standing up an edit team.
mission_body:
Most streamers produce hours of content every week and then lose the best moments in the VOD. Scrubbing by hand is slow. Hiring editors is expensive. Clips sit unused while the channel waits.

We built AuraFlux around Peaks: YouTube Most Replayed, Twitch chat spikes, and Kick CCV. Find the window, stage a trim, run the production pipeline, and publish from the member portal.
blockquote: Every creator should ship like a media team. That is a software problem, not a staffing problem.

diff_cards.headline: Peaks first
diff_cards.body: YouTube Most Replayed, Twitch chat spikes, and Kick live CCV live in the member portal so you start from signal, not a blank timeline.

diff_cards.headline: Spec-driven pipeline
diff_cards.body: Jobs declare which portals run. Skipped portals are not failures. The environment adapts to the job.

diff_cards.headline: QA before publish
diff_cards.body: Portal QA marks compliant or non-compliant before content leaves the system.

diff_cards.headline: Publish from the app
diff_cards.body: Connect social accounts once. Ship Shorts with metadata from the job instead of re-uploading everywhere by hand.

diff_cards.headline: One plan + Managed inquiry
diff_cards.body: Self-serve Peaks and publish on one AuraFlux plan. Inquire about Managed when you want done-for-you production and account management.

diff_cards.headline: API by invite
diff_cards.body: Tech buyers who want platform-signal Peaks programmatically can request API access for review. Most creators start with Peaks in the dashboard.

cta_headline: Ready to ship Shorts from Peaks?
cta_sub: Open Peaks for Most Replayed, chat spikes, and CCV in the member portal.
founder_bio: Built AuraFlux after watching creators lose hours scrubbing VODs for moments that should have shipped the same day.
diff_sub: Not a single-clip editor. A production environment.
